decisions.KEEP_STANDARD: Standard product commitment and mandatory regression scope
decisions.MERGE_INTO_STANDARD: Valuable behavior consolidated into a smaller task-oriented surface
decisions.INDUSTRY_PACK: Optional industry or compliance capability isolated from standard-core
decisions.INTERNAL_CONSOLE: Implementation or operations capability hidden from business users
decisions.HIDE_UNTIL_READY: Potentially valuable capability that does not meet release gates
decisions.RETIRE_AFTER_OBSERVATION: Deprecated or duplicate capability removed only after observation and rollback preparation
